newsitem.title: GREECE: Lithuania's president visits Greece for talks.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania's president visits Greece for talks.

text.p: Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas discussed European Union and NATO issues with Greek officials on Monday, the first day of his visit to Athens.

"We discussed the political expansion of NATO, as well as the position of Russia and the role it can play in this process and to the process of forging a European security system," Brazauskas told reporters after meeting Greek President Costis Stephanopoulos
He said the two countries agreed on all European issues.
"Greece is a member of both (EU and NATO) organisations and has gained valuable experience, which could also be useful to us," he added.
The Lithuanian president is scheduled to meet Prime Minister Costas Simitis and other government officials during his two-day visit.
